references.text: The same law prescribing the death penalty for anyone who has sexual relations with an animal is found in Exodus, establishing this prohibition earlier in the Torah.
This verse forbids sexual intercourse with animals and calls it an abomination, forming the basis for the death penalty prescribed in Leviticus 20:15.
Repeats the curse against anyone who lies with any animal and confirms the seriousness of this sin in Deuteronomy.
